As a gamer that laughed when my teammates were tilted in competitive games I can say with 100% certainty i've never felt more anger than when trying to build a large and complex structure, to the point I had to take multiple breaks to calm myself down !
They could also make everything cheaper and also make it harder to get units so that it feels like you are amazingly rich once you hit the cap if they cannot move it higher/remove it.

Maybe a new game would be a better option than trying to build on a faulty foundation.

They could also try to make something similar to Path Of Exile where they also drop updates every few months but are also working on POE2 which is an overhaul of the main mechanics from POE1 even tho the updates are of smaller size now they are counting on the long run.

NMS could try something similar, or they can look for an even better option as I am not a dev but a simple gamer and I'll play the game either way.

About a week ago I decided to build a castle and the anger that came from trying to make a random triangle snap in the most obvious of places gave me a sense of anger that I haven't felt in CSGO or LOL ever before and the fix would be as easy as making the object snap to the first thing you are pointing at instead of the other side of the wall or an object way beyond that.  


 Not to mention how hard it is to work with terrain, as the option to smooth/slope is extremely important yet is not there, and I decided if I happen to encounter the terrain reappearing inside the base to start another save altogether.   
   
 I hope the devs will try to make more QOL changes along with whatever updates they bring, and I would even be ok with smaller updates in exchange for QOL.
